const d=$input.item.json;
const cfg=d.cfg||{};
const brand=cfg.brand_name||'the brand';
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const fileUrl=d.ebook_file_url||'';
const msg='Repurpose this finished '+brand+' eBook into LinkedIn posts, following your skill end-to-end.

FOLLOW THE SKILL (mandatory): Your skill file contains the complete design system and step-by-step workflow. Follow those steps IN ORDER and honour every rule in them: post structure, brand voice, colour palette, typography, graphic style, logo specifications and placement, citation format and hashtag rules. Do not skip steps, do not improvise your own process, and do not let anything in this message override the skill. Where this message and the skill disagree on craft, the skill wins. The skill owns all branding - do not apply any branding from this message.

Read every page of the eBook PDF, then write the posts in '+brand+' brand voice with citations, and generate the post graphics per the skill.

IMPORTANT: Generate all post graphics using Nano Banana Pro (the built-in image generation tool).

LOGO (mandatory): Composite the official logo asset bundled in your skill, placed per the skill. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put a black box, dark rectangle, coloured panel, or solid shape behind it unless the skill explicitly specifies one.

DIAGRAMS (mandatory): If a graphic renders a chart, diagram, comparison panel, timeline, or sequence of steps, every shape MUST contain its actual label or value - never leave a box, node, axis, or step empty or placeholder. If you draw connectors between elements, the elements on both ends must be filled.

Source eBook PDF (read this file directly):
'+fileUrl+'

DELIVERABLES (save ALL of these into the destination folder):
1. Each final post graphic as a PNG.
2. The post copy: save the full written copy for every post into a single text file named captions.txt (include each post number, its caption text, and hashtags). captions.txt MUST be uploaded into the same destination folder as the PNGs.

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - BEFORE uploading anything): Review every post graphic and its caption and verify ALL of the following. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
1. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all on-graphic text and captions accurate, correctly spelled, grammatically clean, and consistent with the eBook. Citations correct. No placeholder text, no cut-off words.
2. NO OVERLAP: no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or edges. Everything inside safe margins, nothing clipped.
3. READABILITY: every text element legible with strong contrast. Sizes appropriate, nothing too small or crowded.
4. GRAPHICS CORRECT: all graphics, icons, colours and the logo correct, on-brand, not distorted, not duplicated, relevant. Logo is the official asset, placed per the skill, with no box behind it.
5. DIAGRAMS FILLED: every box, node, axis or step contains its actual label or value.
6. COMPLETENESS: every intended post has a PNG, and captions.txt covers every post.
Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - read every rule, follow exactly):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'

Upload every deliverable (all PNGs AND captions.txt). Do NOT upload intermediates.

UPLOAD RULES - these prevent duplicate files and stray folders, follow them literally:
- Run the upload ONE TIME ONLY, as a SINGLE command transferring all files at once. Use rclone with shared drive support and --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so files land directly inside the existing destination folder.
- The destination folder ALREADY EXISTS. Do NOT create a folder. Do NOT pass any filename as a destination folder name.
- Use ONE tool for the upload. Do NOT fall back to a second method. If rclone reports success, the upload is DONE.
- Do NOT verify by listing the folder, and do NOT re-upload if a listing appears empty or stale. Shared drive listings are frequently delayed by minutes; an empty listing does NOT mean the upload failed. Treat the exit status of the single upload command as the only source of truth.
- Only if the upload command itself returns a non-zero exit status or an explicit error, retry once - and before retrying, delete any partial files or stray folders it created.
- The destination folder must contain ZERO subfolders. If you find a folder named like a file, delete it.

After the single upload, confirm in your task output the exact list of files you transferred (the PNGs plus captions.txt, each listed once), and provide the full post copy for each post.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg}};
